user.title: Value IP PDU
user.description:
Connect to your VALUE IP PDU at its HTTP management interface.

Note: the PDU measures and shows voltage on its display, but the web interface never exposes it. Power (W) is therefore computed as voltage × current — optionally from a separate voltage source sensor, otherwise from the nominal voltage constant below.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the PDU. Check the host and credentials.

init.title: Value IP PDU options
init.description:
Adjust credentials, polling and power calculation settings.

Voltage: the PDU's web interface does not expose voltage (only its display shows it). Select a voltage source sensor for accurate power readings, or use the nominal voltage constant.

Outlet names: give each port a memorable name (e.g. which device is plugged into it).

Read-only: lock an outlet so it cannot be switched or power-cycled (security). Its state stays visible.
